Every screenshot you take hangs on a line at the top of your screen. Click to copy, drag out (one or a picked group), double click to open.

**Windows:** download `Hangshot-windows-x64.zip`, unzip, run `Hangshot.exe`. The build is not code signed, so SmartScreen asks once: More info → Run anyway.

**Linux (x64):** download `Hangshot-linux-x64.tar.gz`, then `tar xzf Hangshot-linux-x64.tar.gz && ./Hangshot`. Or from source: `pip install PySide6 && python windows-linux/hangshot.py`.

**Mac:** build from source, see the README.

Based on [Tendedero](https://github.com/alejandrobujan/tendedero) by Alejandro Buján (MIT).
